purpose: Run bounded Claude Code tasks in isolated workspaces with independent verification.

trigger: Delegate this module refactor to Claude Code CLI
Have Claude Code inspect a diff read-only
Use Claude Code to troubleshoot this test under a strict budget
do_not_trigger: Bypass an agent confirmation or usage limit
Modify unrelated repositories with global write scope

preflight: Verify installed Claude CLI identity, version, official execution mode and budget.
Isolate worktree and enumerate exact tool, filesystem and network capabilities.
Require owner approval for any autonomous shell/file-writing run.
workflow: Prepare narrow task contract and acceptance tests.
Run in a bounded scope, capturing the command and process lifecycle.
Review proposed changes and test results independently.
Reconcile unknown side effects and preserve checkpoint on timeout.

evidence.how_to_verify: Pin exact expected head, worktree and allowed paths.
Record read-only findings with supporting changed-line evidence.
Owner confirms agent tool access, quotas and execution scope.
Read back actual changed files and final SHA rather than agent summary.
Capture independent test command, exit code and relevant logs.

failure_modes: Stop and preserve worktree on quota exhaustion or child process loss.
Never silently grant wider tool permissions after a failed attempt.
